message:
Fair price, but not the cheapest local offer.
• Mobileleb: $42.00, explicitly Brand New; white, black, blue and pink are listed in stock. Beirut delivery fee could not be verified.
• Classic Phones: $31.00 for white or yellow; blue is $35.00. Listed in stock, but condition is not stated and the description conflicts with the color options. Delivery across Lebanon is advertised; taxes and shipping are calculated at checkout.
• Abed Tahan: $39.00 for black, listed in stock. Delivery across Lebanon is advertised, but the fee and new condition are unconfirmed.
The WH-CH520 offers up to 50-hour battery life and multipoint Bluetooth; it is an on-ear model without active noise cancellation.
My suggestion: check Classic Phones’ condition and final delivered total first. Mobileleb is reasonable if explicit brand-new condition matters more than the lowest price.
